items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then Pee Wee. And I never know who he was. ... [INTERVIEWEE] He was.

ctx.x: He was really fooling around more with the piano. Wait a minute. I think it was 21. 21 because the year before I left my first wife. Because I played with the Trum Boy on, what's he called them? C Melody. C Melody. Yeah. Trum Boy. Bix was on piano then.
Bix played piano. And then Pee Wee. And I never know who he was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was. He was.
